integrity: The covariance and both variances are derived from differentiated Dirichlet gamma moments, with the asymptotic correlation following from an explicit harmonic-number expansion. The accompanying numerical-symbolic replay is supplementary and does not substitute for the all-dimension proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas are for the uniform Dirichlet spacing vector and are not asserted for arbitrary Dirichlet parameters.
The entropy is the Shannon entropy of the spacing vector, not the unweighted sum of log spacings used in some classical goodness-of-fit tests.
General Dirichlet differentiation makes the mixed moment accessible; older compositional or spacing literature may contain an equivalent covariance in different notation.
title: Greenwood dispersion and spacing entropy remain strongly anticorrelated
